{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: Show monthly revenue for 2025.", "sql": "SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM invoices
WHERE status = 'paid'
  AND invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month"}
